<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Subscription" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/subscription">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subscription" name="Subscription Lifecycle" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Subscription">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Signup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SignUp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Cancel_Decision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitCancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="Subscription System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignAccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TriggerBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Notify_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendNotifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Support" name="Support Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessCancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyRefunds</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeactivateSubscription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SettleBalance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Concluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Signup" name="Customer signs up">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SignUp" name="Sign up for subscription service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateAccount" name="Generate account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AssignAccess" name="Assign access">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_TriggerBilling" name="Trigger automated billing cycles">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Notify_Merge" name="Subscription active" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendNotifications" name="Send updates, enhancements or renewal notifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Cancel_Decision" name="Customer decides to cancel?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitCancellation" name="Submit cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessCancellation" name="Process cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ApplyRefunds" name="Apply refunds or charges according to terms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DeactivateSubscription" name="Deactivate subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Concluded" name="Subscription concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Signup" targetRef="Task_SignUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SignUp" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Task_AssignAccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_AssignAccess" targetRef="Task_TriggerBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_TriggerBilling" targetRef="Gateway_Notify_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_Notify_Merge" targetRef="Task_SendNotifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_SendNotifications" targetRef="Gateway_Cancel_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" name="No, remains subscribed" sourceRef="Gateway_Cancel_Decision" targetRef="Gateway_Notify_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" name="Yes, cancels" sourceRef="Gateway_Cancel_Decision" targetRef="Task_SubmitCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_SubmitCancellation" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancellation" targetRef="Task_ApplyRefunds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ApplyRefunds" targetRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="EndEvent_Concluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
